name: Young elf student
description: A young elf wolf-rider student in her first training session who falls from the beam.

description_citations.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
description_citations.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: A young elf falls with her wolf from a training beam during her first lesson, and Ruzi asks her to say what she did wrong.
timeline.quote: "Tell me what you did wrong," Ruzi said to his two-legged student.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi and his wolf Kuma cross the high beam without hesitation to teach his students to trust their wolves.
timeline.quote: But Ruzi urged his wolf forward without hesitation.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

relations.note: He is the Master Trainer who teaches her.
relations.quote: As Master Trainer, Ruzi taught the youngest Selesnyans and their wolves to become Wolf Riders.

citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.
